items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And from Zack, I went to Speed Webb.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, you know, the word got around that he was playing with (?)... The only thing, I had the bad rap on me that said, "He'll all right, but man, if he ever gets drunk and starts crying, he won't be there til next morning." Heh-heh. They said, "That cat can play, but man, he don't stay nowhere." That was the tag on me, you know. But they didn't ever know why I didn't stay nowhere. Because either the money wasn't coming through, or something went down wrong!

Yeah, I went with... See, I worked around there with McKinney's Cotton Pickers for a while, you know. No, I mean, the Chocolate Dandies. Then I went with Zack. And from Zack, I went to Speed Webb. I wasn't with Zack but
